name: @local/dsh-sidebar-browser-control
description: Sidebar Agent Browser for DeepSeek Harness: an owned webview plus Agent tools (snapshot/click/type/scroll) driven through a loopback bridge, with an in-page virtual cursor that never moves the user's real mouse, plus QA actions for viewport/evaluate/metrics/screenshots/theme emulation and local preview.

scripts.test: node --test tests/bridge.test.mjs tests/browser-control-client.test.mjs tests/browser-control-host.test.mjs tests/browser-control-scripts.test.mjs tests/preview.test.mjs
